card.name: Words before temperature, form or dose
card.fires_on: Modifier words that come right before a noun like temperature, form, doses or levels, mainly "room" before "temperature" and "any" before "form".

modes.label: Room temperature
modes.description: The word "room" in storage or handling instructions, just before "temperature".
modes.example: Bring the vial to<< room>> temperature prior to reconstitution with Sterile

modes.label: Any form / doses
modes.description: Words such as "any", "the" or the end of "analgesic" or "lipid-modifying" before "form", "doses" or "levels".

card.plain: It marks a word that is about to be followed by a noun for a measured quantity, such as room temperature or dose level.
